Our jobs aren’t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out. Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique. Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay. They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done. Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success – creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts – to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.

Citi Commercial Bank (CCB) works with mid-market and fast growth businesses across the world, especially clients with international presence and aspirations. The Middle East & Africa (MEA) CCB Services Sales Head will work closely with the CCB heads across CCB’s MEA footprint to serve Commercial Banking’s top clients & prospects in these markets across the full suite of Services products, as well as with the franchise leadership, Corporate, Commercial & Public sector (CCPS) sales, and Services product partners across the cluster and the broader Citi network. The incumbent will drive new client origination and share of wallet growth, manage a team of high performing individuals and be a senior expert in their field. This is a team leader role, expected to partner and influence decision makers across clients and within the bank with an aim to make Citi the go to international banking partner for our client segments.

d: The Project Manager is responsible for planning, executing, monitoring, and delivering projects within the approved scope, timeline, and budget. The role requires working primarily on-site to oversee daily project activities, supervise progress, coordinate with site teams, contractors, consultants, and other stakeholders, and ensure that all work is carried out according to approved plans, specifications, safety standards, and quality requirements. The Project Manager is also responsible for managing project resources, monitoring schedules and costs, identifying and resolving site-related issues, preparing progress reports, and ensuring timely project completion while maintaining effective communication and coordination throughout the project lifecycle.
q: Minimum of 10 years of experience in project management, preferably in construction and architectural projects.
Proven experience managing and supervising projects on-site from initiation to completion.
Strong knowledge of construction processes, architectural drawings, technical specifications, and project execution.
Experience in project planning, scheduling, budgeting, cost control, and resource management.
Ability to coordinate effectively with contractors, consultants, subcontractors, and site teams.
Fluency in English; Arabic is an advantage.
